study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Liu et al., Progress in Neuropsychopharmacology & Biological Psychiatry, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Individualized functional connectome abnormalities obtained using two normative model unveil neurophysiological subtypes of obsessive compulsive disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Identify neurophysiological OCD subtypes by deriving individualized deviations in functional connectivity strength (FCS) using a normative modeling framework, and assess clinical differences between subtypes.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Single-center dataset from First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper clearly states that participants were recruited from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. There is no mention of using an established multi-site dataset or publicly available cohort. The healthy controls were 'enlisted from the community via poster advertisements' at this single institution.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Atotal of ninety-eight first-episode and untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... Healthy controls (HCs, n = 104) were enlisted from the community via poster advertisements.

rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: 104 healthy controls were included in the study.

rci3_hc_age.answer: Phase: Uninvestigated | mean: 23.14 | sd: 5.64 | median: NR | iqr: NR | min: NR | max: NR
rci3_hc_age.reason: Age of HCs provided in Table 1.

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Table 1 shows that 51 of the 104 healthy controls were male (49.04%). Since total N=104, females = 104-51 = 53 (50.96%, rounded to 51.0% for females and 49.0% for males to sum to 100%).

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Scan acquisition section describes resting-state functional images with GRE-EPI.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: A total of 242 contiguous wholebrain resting-state functional images were acquired ... using gradient echo echo-planar-imaging (GRE-EPI) sequences.

nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: Gaussian process regression model was trained ... within HCs.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Normative modeling of ROI-wise FCS uncovered two OCD subtypes with opposite deviation patterns; pooled patients showed no significant FCS abnormalities versus HCs; subtypes differed in age of onset.
